description: Ordered root-cause rules for host_validation_triage.py. The first rule whose 'when' clauses all match wins (clauses are AND-ed); unmatched jobs are UNKNOWN and emit their signature so this table can be extended. Clause keys: state/terminalState/validationStatus/resultStatus/terminalPassed (exact values, case-insensitive), exceptionClass/message/frame (regex on the first exception block and its caused-by chain), marker (regex on *_RESULT / *_FAILURE / TIMED_OUT / UNAVAILABLE log markers), console (regex on cubism-console.txt ERROR exception heads), failureText (regex on result-properties failure.N, unexpectedFailure actuals, per-assertion actuals and failure-marker log lines), evidenceProperty (regex on 'key=value' lines from the runner's evidence properties files: deferred-check.properties, launch-diagnostics.properties). Jobs with no usable evidence at all (reclaimed by retention, or a log that ended before any verdict) are classified NO_EVIDENCE in code, not by a rule here. License startup markers (START_PRO_TRIAL_SELECTED, PRO_TRIAL_CONFIRMED, PRO_TRIAL_ACTIVATED_ACKNOWLEDGED, ACTIVE_TRIAL_WELCOME_ACKNOWLEDGED, HOME_NEWS_DIALOG_CLOSED, START_FREE_SELECTED, FREE_PARAMETER_LIMIT_ACKNOWLEDGED, FREE_WELCOME_CONFIRMED) are emitted by the NativeStartupAssistanceAgent on every installation — the user-authorized PRO trial start is preferred over the FREE fallback — and are never treated as failure evidence.

the host exposes no workspace layout provider on this version (5.0.x): the matrix proves typed UNAVAILABLE handling and every emitted assertion passed, so the verdict reflects an absent host capability, not probe drift — record the boundary

the mcp standard variant requires a Glue-bearing fixture but the resolved fixture has none (mcp result error=); set TURBOISM_HOST_VALIDATION_FIXTURE_MCP or TURBOISM_HOST_VALIDATION_FIXTURE_CLIPMASK to the mask/Glue-bearing fixture instead of retrying

when.failureText: backupNow failed|auto-backup completion timeout|auto-backup backup directory is unavailable

rules.advice: native auto-backup produced no artifact and never advanced lastAutoBackupTime inside the poll window on this host/profile (AutoBackupCoordinator completion-timeout throw site, ~runtime/.../AutoBackupCoordinator.java:445-555). The probe exercised the host's own backupNow() the same way it does on passing versions, so the absence is a host-side capability boundary on this version/license profile, not a probe defect — record the boundary instead of retrying

the runtime installs no verified authoring-transaction backend on this host version (5.0.x/5.1.x), so turboism.transaction.execute returns typed UNAVAILABLE while every other emitted assertion passes — a documented capability boundary, not probe drift; record the boundary instead of retrying
